description: Making one of my favorite cookie recipes 🤎 Recipe by erin clarke on wellplated.com #healthyrecipes #baking #oatmealcookies #healthysnacks #bakingrecipe
transcript: Let's make some healthy peanut butter oatmeal cookies. Give yourself a large bowl. Pour two cups of oats, one and one-half teaspoon of baking powder, one-eighth teaspoon of baking soda, one-fourth teaspoon of cinnamon, one-half teaspoon of salt, and then whisk it together. Then get a medium-sized bowl. My least favorite part, I put a half cup of creamy peanut butter. Then one large egg at room temperature, one teaspoon vanilla extract, one-half cup of honey. Then whisk until blended. Then put the liquid mixture into the dry mixture and mix it together until it's combined. This mixture is going to be wet and sticky. Then I put a fourth cup of chocolate chips and a fourth cup of peanut butter chips. Put it in the fridge for at least 30 minutes, up to three days, and take it out. And this is what it should look like. Get a pan lined with parchment paper and heat the oven up to 350 degrees Fahrenheit. I use an ice cream scoop to put the cookies down, and then I flatten them with a fork. Kitty! And then this is what they are supposed to look like. They're right uneven, but I'm good. Just try your best to make them even. Then bake them for nine to 10 minutes. They should be a little golden at the edges. They may not be the prettiest, but they're pretty good.
